title: fix(plugin-list): a condition chip names an advanced-panel operator in the panel's words, never by its id
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9GPJ8pmbK219Pay95x25Uno)_
Fixes #36462
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表与仪表盘钻取弹窗里的筛选条件标签，原来在冒号后直接显示操作符的内部代号，现在显示与高级筛选面板下拉项一致的文字，如「金额：不为 null」「金额：大于 100」。
- 属于列表筛选体验打磨，替在 CRM 仪表盘做钻取的业务用户解决看不懂条件的问题。
- 只影响条件标签上的文字；万一措辞不合适，读者看到的是一个可读词而不是机器名，撤回这次合并即可恢复原样。
- 无

## What changes

`quickOperatorLabel` (plugin-list's condition chip and quick-filter operator wording) returned the raw operator id for every operator outside its 13 quick-filter words. A drill dialog's base filter carries `['amount', 'is_not_null', true]`, so the chip read "Deal Value: is_not_null" (HotCRM: 「金额：is_not_null」, 「阶段：not_equals 失败」).

- **The five operators the card names** (`not_equals`, `greater_than`, `less_than`, `is_null`, `is_not_null`) now read the advanced filter panel's own key for each operator, `filterBuilder.operators.ID` — the same key the panel's dropdown row draws. No new key: every one of the 11 packs already translates them, so no locale pack changes and a chip can never word an operator differently from the panel. The provider-less defaults table gains the seven rows verbatim from the en pack (as it already does for the dashboard range keys); `check:i18n-keys` holds them equal.
- **Bounded in-place fix, same defect class:** `icontains` and `ends_with` are also operators only the advanced panel writes (its text operator list offers both) and showed their id the same way; they take the same one-line arm each. All four exemption conditions hold: same defect class, mechanical with the form pinned by the five above, same file surface the claim declares, same gate family.
- **Unknown operator fallback:** any other spelling now reads `listConditions.filter.operator` ("Condition" / 「条件」), the quick filter's existing name for the operator control, already in all 11 packs. A view triple's comparison symbol (`=`, `!=`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`) still reads as written ("Amount: >= 10"), which existing pins hold.
- `describeConditionValue`: a named operator with no value text is now the operator alone, never followed by a trailing space ("Deal Value: Condition", not "Deal Value: Condition " for a value-less unknown operator). `is_null` / `is_not_null` were already in `isValuelessOperator`'s set, so their chips carry no value: "Deal Value: Is not null".

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the shared harness `listConditions.test.tsx` (`ConditionChipRow — an operator only the advanced panel writes`): the chip text for each of the seven operators in en and zh-CN; the reader's own filter chip; every pack words each of the seven and never as the id; the unknown-operator fallback in en and zh-CN; a CONTROL that symbols still read as written. No existing test was changed.

<details><summary>Runs at head 66eb08bc</summary>

- `vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/conditions/` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0): Test Files 2 passed, Tests 74 passed.
- Full package, `vitest run packages/plugin-list/` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0): Test Files 185 passed (185), Tests 2032 passed (2032).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation 1, `ablation-replace.mjs --delete` of the `is_not_null` arm: mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0), 3 failed / 3 passed of the new describe ("Received: Deal Value: Condition"); restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2, fallback `default:` back to `return operator`: mutation landed, 1 failed (the fallback test) / 5 passed; restored, blob == HEAD.
- `pnpm --dir ui check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`: exit 0 each.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The card's example said "Deal Value: is set"; the chip reads "Deal Value: Is not null".** To do 1 says to reuse the advanced panel's own operator wording, and the panel's word for `is_not_null` is "Is not null" (「不为 null」). "Is set" is the panel's word for a different operator, `exists`, whose fold onto `is_not_null` the filter-builder header records as refused (objectui#9559 ruling B: two labels for one wire predicate). Rewording "null" for business readers would change the panel and the chip together, since they now share one key; that is a wording decision for the panel, not done here.
- **Casing:** the panel's words are sentence-case ("Greater than"), the quick filter's own 13 are lower-case ("is any of"), so an en chip can read "Deal Value: Greater than 100" beside "Stage: is any of". Reusing the panel's keys was chosen over a new chip-cased key per operator in each of the 11 packs to keep one wording per operator and no locale pack edits; CJK packs are unaffected.
- **Symbols from view triples** still read as written ("Amount: >= 10", where the quick filter says "≥ 10"). Observation only, unchanged and pinned by existing tests.
- Lowered AST spellings that are not canonical ids (`nin`, `isnotnull`, `startswith`) reach the chip only from a hand-written view filter; they now read "Condition", readable but unspecific. Observation only.

## Verification

Read first: `conditionTranslations.ts` (the new arms and the `default:`), then `ListConditionControls.tsx` (`describeConditionValue`'s last return).

Two-minute check: `cd ui && npx vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/conditions/__tests__/listConditions.test.tsx -t "advanced panel writes"` shows 6 passing tests, among them the en chips "Deal Value: Is not null" and the zh-CN chips 「金额：不为 null」.
